original:
Theorem 2.

Let $a>0,~b>1$ so that $1+ka\leq 2b^{k}$ for all integers $k\geq 1$ and $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices, $m$ edges and $\kappa$ connected components. Then

$\displaystyle\frac{T_{G}(1,1)}{T_{G}(0,2)}\leq\frac{b^{m}}{a^{m-n+\kappa}}$ 
 $\displaystyle\text{if $G$ is bridgeless.}$
type: ∀ (V : Type u_1) (E : Type u_2) [Fintype V] [inst : Fintype E] (G : Graph V E) (a b : ℝ), 0 < a → 1 < b → (∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k → 1 + ↑k * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k) → (∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ¬Mathlib2.x2611_15008_bridge G e) → Mathlib2.x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / Mathlib2.x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 ≤ b ^ G.edgeSet.ncard / a ^ (G.edgeSet.ncard + Mathlib2.x2611_15008_components G - G.vertexSet.ncard)

lemma x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux1 (c R x y : ℝ)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) (hR : 1 ≤ R) (hc : 1 + c ≤ 2 * R) :
    c * x + y ≤ R * (x + y) := by
  have h₁ := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hR) (sub_nonneg.mpr hxy)
  have h₂ := mul_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2 * R - c - 1) hx
  nlinarith

lemma x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux2 (I : Type*)
    (m d : I → ℕ) (t u : I → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b)
    (hab : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k)
    (hzero : ∀ i, m i = 0 → t i = 1 ∧ u i = 1 ∧ d i = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ i, 0 < m i → ∃ (k : ℕ) (j : I), 1 ≤ k ∧
      m j + k = m i ∧ d j + 1 = d i ∧
      ((t i = (k : ℝ) * t j ∧ u i = 2 * u j) ∨
        ∃ l : I, m l + k = m i ∧ d l = d i ∧ u j ≤ u l ∧
          t i = (k : ℝ) * t j + t l ∧ u i = u j + u l)) :
    ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ t i * a ^ d i ≤ u i * b ^ m i := by
  have hb0 : 0 < b := lt_trans zero_lt_one hb
  have key : ∀ n i, m i = n → 0 < u i ∧ t i * a ^ d i ≤ u i * b ^ m i := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro i hmi
      by_cases hn : n = 0
      · obtain ⟨ht, hu, hd⟩ := hzero i (hmi.trans hn)
        simp [ht, hu, hd, hmi, hn]
      · obtain ⟨k, j, hk, hmj, hdj, hcases⟩ := hstep i (by omega)
        have hj := ih (m j) (by omega) j rfl
        have huj : 0 < u j := hj.1
        have hka : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) * a := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) ha.le
        rcases hcases with ⟨ht, hu⟩ | ⟨l, hml, hdl, hujl, ht, hu⟩
        · refine ⟨by rw [hu]; positivity, ?_⟩
          calc
            t i * a ^ d i = ((k : ℝ) * a) * (t j * a ^ d j) := by
              rw [ht, ← hdj, pow_succ]; ring
            _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) * a) * (u j * b ^ m j) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj.2 hka
            _ ≤ (2 * b ^ k) * (u j * b ^ m j) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hab k hk]) (by positivity)
            _ = u i * b ^ m i := by rw [hu, ← hmj, pow_add]; ring
        · have hl := ih (m l) (by omega) l rfl
          have hul : 0 < u l := hl.1
          have hw := x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux1
            ((k : ℝ) * a) (b ^ k) (u j) (u l) hj.1.le hujl
            (one_le_pow₀ hb.le) (hab k hk)
          have heq : m l = m j := by omega
          refine ⟨by rw [hu]; positivity, ?_⟩
          calc
            t i * a ^ d i = ((k : ℝ) * a) * (t j * a ^ d j) +
                t l * a ^ d l := by
              rw [ht, hdl, ← hdj, pow_succ]; ring
            _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) * a) * (u j * b ^ m j) + u l * b ^ m l :=
              add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj.2 hka) hl.2
            _ = b ^ m j * (((k : ℝ) * a) * u j + u l) := by rw [heq]; ring
            _ ≤ b ^ m j * (b ^ k * (u j + u l)) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (by positivity)
            _ = u i * b ^ m i := by rw [hu, ← hmj, pow_add]; ring
  exact fun i => key (m i) i rfl

lemma x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux3 {V E : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : Graph V E) : x2611_15008_components G ≤ G.vertexSet.ncard := by
  exact Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective G.toSimpleGraph.connectedComponentMk
    (fun c => Quot.inductionOn c (fun v => ⟨v, rfl⟩))

lemma x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux4 {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (G : Graph V E) (h : G.edgeSet.ncard = 0) :
    x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 = 1 ∧ x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 = 1 ∧
      G.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components G - G.vertexSet.ncard = 0 := by
  classical
  have he : G.edgeSet = ∅ := (Set.ncard_eq_zero (Set.toFinite _)).mp h
  have hc := x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux3 G
  have hs : G.restrict (∅ : Set E) = G :=
    (Graph.restrict_eq_self_iff G ∅).mpr (by simp [he])
  have hd : x2611_15008_components G - G.vertexSet.ncard = 0 := by omega
  simp [x2611_15008_Tutte, he, hs, hd, h]

lemma x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux5 {V W E : Type*}

lemma x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux6 {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (G : Graph V E) (hG : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ¬ x2611_15008_bridge G e)
    (hm : 0 < G.edgeSet.ncard) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (D : Graph V E), 1 ≤ k ∧

        x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 = 2 * x2611_15008_Tutte D 0 2) ∨
       ∃ f : V → V,
        (∀ e ∈ (D.map f).edgeSet, ¬ x2611_15008_bridge (D.map f) e) ∧

        (D.map f).edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components (D.map f) -

        x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 =
          (k : ℝ) * x2611_15008_Tutte D 1 1 + x2611_15008_Tutte (D.map f) 1 1 ∧
        x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 =
          x2611_15008_Tutte D 0 2 + x2611_15008_Tutte (D.map f) 0 2) := by
  sorry

theorem x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless (V E : Type*) [Fintype V] [Fintype E]
    (G : Graph V E) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 1 < b)
    (hab : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 + (k : ℝ) * a ≤ 2 * b ^ k)
    (hG : ∀ e ∈ G.edgeSet, ¬ x2611_15008_bridge G e) :
    x2611_15008_Tutte G 1 1 / x2611_15008_Tutte G 0 2 ≤
      b ^ G.edgeSet.ncard /
        a ^ (G.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components G - G.vertexSet.ncard) := by
  let I := {H : Graph V E // ∀ e ∈ H.edgeSet, ¬ x2611_15008_bridge H e}
  have hzero : ∀ i : I, i.val.edgeSet.ncard = 0 →
      x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 1 1 = 1 ∧ x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 0 2 = 1 ∧
        i.val.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components i.val - i.val.vertexSet.ncard = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    exact x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux4 i.val hi
  have hstep : ∀ i : I, 0 < i.val.edgeSet.ncard → ∃ (k : ℕ) (j : I), 1 ≤ k ∧
      j.val.edgeSet.ncard + k = i.val.edgeSet.ncard ∧
      (j.val.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components j.val - j.val.vertexSet.ncard) + 1 =
        i.val.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components i.val - i.val.vertexSet.ncard ∧
      ((x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 1 1 = (k : ℝ) * x2611_15008_Tutte j.val 1 1 ∧
        x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 0 2 = 2 * x2611_15008_Tutte j.val 0 2) ∨
       ∃ l : I, l.val.edgeSet.ncard + k = i.val.edgeSet.ncard ∧
        l.val.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components l.val - l.val.vertexSet.ncard =
          i.val.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components i.val - i.val.vertexSet.ncard ∧
        x2611_15008_Tutte j.val 0 2 ≤ x2611_15008_Tutte l.val 0 2 ∧
        x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 1 1 =
          (k : ℝ) * x2611_15008_Tutte j.val 1 1 + x2611_15008_Tutte l.val 1 1 ∧
        x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 0 2 =
          x2611_15008_Tutte j.val 0 2 + x2611_15008_Tutte l.val 0 2) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨k, D, hk, hD, hmD, hdD, hcases⟩ :=
      x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux6 i.val i.property hi
    refine ⟨k, ⟨D, hD⟩, hk, hmD, hdD, ?_⟩
    rcases hcases with hspecial | ⟨f, hC, hmC, hdC, ht, hu⟩
    · exact Or.inl hspecial
    · exact Or.inr ⟨⟨D.map f, hC⟩, hmC, hdC,
        x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux5 D f, ht, hu⟩
  have h := x2611_15008_thm2_bridgeless_aux2 I
    (fun i => i.val.edgeSet.ncard)
    (fun i => i.val.edgeSet.ncard + x2611_15008_components i.val - i.val.vertexSet.ncard)
    (fun i => x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 1 1) (fun i => x2611_15008_Tutte i.val 0 2)
    a b ha hb hab hzero hstep ⟨G, hG⟩
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ h.1 (pow_pos ha _)).mpr
  simpa only [mul_comm] using h.2
